description: Ministry of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine - The National Medicines Regulatory Authority Act No. 05 of 2015 and Registration and Licensing of Medicines (Fees) Reg. No. 02 of 2017 and operation from 14.06.2017 registration and Licensing of Medical Devices Reg. No. 03 of 2017 and operation from 14.06.2017 - Registration and Licensing of Borderling Produce (Fees) Reg. No. 04 of 2017 and operation from 14.06.2017
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Health under the National Medicines Regulatory Authority Act, establishing fees for medicine registration, licensing, clinical trials, and certifications. It constitutes subsidiary legislation and regulatory framework matters, fitting the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) for legal instruments and regulatory requirements.
